column3: Implemented over the http and sql journal sources; deviations (proposed): sharpit journals the masked statement shape, so one finding per route naming the verb (first keyword of insert, update, delete, merge) instead of per statement fingerprint, and the statement is never shown; unreadable statement text is counted apart and named in the check reason; only EXECUTION provenance is counted (no PREPARATION or orm read, OQ-I6); first keyword is a word, not startsWith; GET and HEAD as BootUI

Answers not applicable with a fixed sharpit reason (proposed deviation): the sql event has phase null and the http event no handler end, so a statement cannot be placed in the response write; BootUI own WebFlux and Quarkus reasons do not describe sharpit; needs a handler-end mark from the FastAPI adapter
